data.name: Drashti
data.gender_notes: Drashti is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Hindu mythology, Drashti represents the power of perception and insight. It is believed that a person with the name Drashti possesses a keen sense of understanding and the ability to see things beyond the physical realm. The name Drashti carries the meaning “Sight, Vision” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Drashti usually hope their child will grow to embody sight, vision and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that signifies deep insight and wisdom.
data.etymology: Drashti belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Sight, Vision.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Drashti total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

data.cultural_impact: The name Drashti is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Drashta', which means 'observer' or 'seer'. In Hindu culture, the name Drashti is associated with the goddess of vision, Mahakali, who is believed to be the witness of all actions. A person bearing this name is believed to possess sharp vision and insight, making them adept observants and astute problem solvers.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Drashti carries deep spiritual significance as it reflects the inner journey of self-awareness and understanding. The Hindu scripture, Upanishads, states, "To know yourself is to know the supreme self". With this name, the bearer is encouraged to dive deep within and gain wisdom and knowledge through perception and insight. The name serves as a constant reminder to seek truth, understand the underlying reality, and awaken the inner consciousness.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Drashti: Perception of the inner truth, the wisdom to see beyond the physical world. It represents the power of insight and discernment.

vedic_reference.note: The name 'Drashti' appears in various Vedic texts, such as the Rigveda and the Mahabharata.

historical_references.reference: Drashti is a Sanskrit word that means 'vision' or 'sight'. It is mentioned in various Hindu scriptures, including the Mahabharata and the Upanishads.
